workstreams.name: Identify core legal framework for construction contract and defect liability
workstreams.goal: Determine applicable provisions under Austrian civil law (BGB) regarding construction contracts, defect liability, and subcontractor liability

workstreams.name: Analyze defect-related claims (Mängelrechte)
workstreams.goal: Assess whether defects constitute non-conformity under §§ 1322 ff. BGB and evaluate remedies (Nacherfüllung, Minderung, Schadensersatz)

workstreams.name: Evaluate subcontractor liability and risk allocation
workstreams.goal: Determine if Ofenbau AG remains liable for acts of Allerlei GmbH under § 1326 BGB and assess liability for additional damage during remediation

synthesis_focus: Liability of general contractor (Ofenbau AG) for defects and consequential damage caused by subcontractor, with emphasis on Wirtschaftlichkeitsgebot and causation under §§ 1322–1328 BGB
